title: The Pebble Bureau Guide to Sharing a Shelf Without Starting a Geological Incident

publisher.name: Bureau of Unnecessary but Surprisingly Useful Pet-Rock Affairs
publisher.editorial_note: Compiled by imaginary shelter staff after several entirely invented domestic incidents. No actual moon was consulted.

scope: Fictional pet-stone cohabitation guidance. These are authored world rules, not geology, biology, clinical advice or measured compatibility probabilities.

coverage.same_type_meaning: Two distinct pets of the same rock type, never one pet paired with itself.
coverage.unlisted_type_policy: Unknown; do not infer a rule for a type outside this edition.

reading_rules: Each pair appears once. Reversing the two type names selects the same entry and verdict. Role-specific advice in prose is still about the named pet type.
Verdicts describe ordinary shared-home suitability in this fictional guide; they are categories, not scores or guarantees.
Individual profiles, recorded experiences and current care needs take precedence when deciding whether a general pairing fits particular pets. Missing individual information remains unknown.
Never overwrite an individual socialization trait, health note or trigger with a type stereotype from this guide.
Current adoption availability and shelter come only from operational case records. A harmonious pair may contain pets unavailable for adoption.
NOT_RECOMMENDED means do not recommend routine cohabitation from this general guide. Brief-visit advice is not an exception authorizing adoption together.
Planetary remarks, imaginary physiology and Bureau anecdotes are jokes inside this fictional world. They require no ephemeris, birth date, tarot service or new pet attributes.
Cite the catalog ID, edition and pair entry ID. Type portraits are background; pair entries supply the actual pair-specific guidance.

verdicts.HARMONIOUS: Generally well matched within the fictional world; follow the household agreement and check the individual pets.
verdicts.CONDITIONAL: A shared home is plausible only when the household can provide the stated accommodations.
verdicts.NOT_RECOMMENDED: Prefer separate households for ordinary long-term cohabitation; good intentions alone do not resolve the described mismatch.

type_portraits.nickname: The retired volcano with a clipboard
type_portraits.temperament: Devoted, punctual and protective; considers a missed bedtime a minor tectonic emergency.
type_portraits.comforts: Predictable evenings, a warm-colored lamp and a job that does not involve supervising everyone.
type_portraits.sensitivities: Being called a cold person; surprise parties disguised as emergency drills.

type_portraits.nickname: The striped improviser with a practical streak
type_portraits.temperament: Resourceful and playful; changes plans cheerfully but remembers who needs warning.
type_portraits.comforts: Projects, music at an agreed volume and permission to be more than one mood.
type_portraits.sensitivities: Being told to pick a single stripe; having improvisation mistaken for dishonesty.

type_portraits.nickname: The committee chair of the windowsill
type_portraits.temperament: Patient and dependable; can turn choosing a cushion into a three-meeting consultation.
type_portraits.comforts: Stable arrangements, shared rituals and companions willing to disagree politely.
type_portraits.sensitivities: Furniture moved without minutes; accusations that its speckles are decorative indecision.

type_portraits.temperament: Nurturing and sentimental; keeps a family story for every invented fossil.
type_portraits.comforts: Gentle conversation, familiar objects and companions who ask before reorganizing memories.
type_portraits.sensitivities: Aggressive cleaning ceremonies; jokes that its ancestors were merely lunch.

type_portraits.nickname: The opera patron who is also the opera
type_portraits.temperament: Affectionate and expressive; believes a compliment should have a lighting plan.
type_portraits.comforts: Regular attention, beautiful little rituals and companions who can decline an encore kindly.
type_portraits.sensitivities: Being ignored during a dramatic entrance; polishing presented as a personality cure.

type_portraits.temperament: Perceptive, private and theatrical; notices every sigh and occasionally invents a sequel.
type_portraits.comforts: Clear affection, permission to retreat and compliments that are not jokes about sharpness.
type_portraits.sensitivities: Public teasing, unexpected touching and people reading its reflective surface as an invitation.

type_portraits.nickname: The social balloon with a geological passport
type_portraits.temperament: Bouncy, curious and easily delighted; invites the postbox to birthdays.
type_portraits.comforts: Company, short playful activities and help remembering that quiet companions still like it.
type_portraits.sensitivities: Long punitive silences; being told to calm down without being offered something else to do.

type_portraits.nickname: The traveler who brings the beach indoors
type_portraits.temperament: Adaptable and affectionate; leaves emotional breadcrumbs and imaginary sand in every friendship.
type_portraits.comforts: Room for small adventures, a welcoming return ritual and no shame about untidiness.
type_portraits.sensitivities: Being treated as a renovation problem; promises of permanent stillness.

type_portraits.nickname: The archivist with too many feelings on separate pages
type_portraits.temperament: Observant, softly funny and easily overstimulated; needs time to unfold an opinion.
type_portraits.comforts: Low-volume conversation, patient invitations and a private shelf nobody borrows.
type_portraits.sensitivities: Being rushed to open up; communal confession games and leaf-blower impressions.

type_portraits.nickname: The minimalist librarian of other people's chaos
type_portraits.temperament: Quiet, precise and dryly affectionate; writes wonderful notes instead of making speeches.
type_portraits.comforts: Clear boundaries, uncluttered space and companionship that does not require constant talking.
type_portraits.sensitivities: Loud scraping sounds; anyone calling silence a relationship defect.

pairings.title: Two captains, one bedtime
pairings.explanation: Their loyalty is excellent, but both may issue the evening instructions and wait for the other to salute.
pairings.household_agreement: Alternate responsibility for the bedtime bell; give each a separate small project.
pairings.avoid: Do not appoint both chief safety officer of the same cushion.
pairings.bureau_note: At Pebble Haven, a disagreement about lights-out ended only when the lamp joined a union.

pairings.title: Jazz with a reliable fire exit
pairings.explanation: Gneiss welcomes a steady partner without losing its playful streak. Basalt appreciates an improviser who still remembers the agreed essentials.
pairings.household_agreement: Keep core routines stable and let Gneiss choose optional variations.
pairings.avoid: Do not rewrite essential agreements in the middle of a joke.
pairings.bureau_note: Their emergency meeting accidentally became a very well-organized jazz quartet.

pairings.title: The neighborhood watch that remembers birthdays
pairings.explanation: Basalt supplies initiative and Granite supplies patience. Their shared love of routines makes affection look like a carefully maintained timetable.
pairings.household_agreement: Give them one shared ritual and some unstructured time without an agenda.
pairings.avoid: Do not let sensible planning consume every playful activity.
pairings.bureau_note: They once prepared a fire drill for a birthday candle, then baked the birthday an apology.

pairings.title: Security for the family scrapbook
pairings.explanation: Basalt guards traditions that Limestone loves sharing. Both enjoy care expressed through small dependable acts.
pairings.household_agreement: Let Limestone choose the evening story and Basalt arrange the cozy seating.
pairings.avoid: Do not turn family traditions into mandatory inspections.
pairings.bureau_note: The scrapbook now has both a ribbon bookmark and an entirely unnecessary visitor badge.

pairings.title: Emergency siren versus opening night
pairings.explanation: Marble reads enthusiastic applause as affection; Basalt treats every encore as a preventable disruption. Shared routines become daily negotiations about who is too much.
pairings.household_agreement: Prefer separate households; for short visits provide separate resting spaces and a clear end time.
pairings.avoid: Do not ask Marble to become invisible or Basalt to enjoy continuous premieres.
pairings.bureau_note: The Bureau blames Mercury being in the Moon. The actual complaint form says: six curtain calls after bedtime.

pairings.title: Practical love meets dramatic subtitles
pairings.explanation: Basalt shows care by fixing problems; Obsidian wants its feelings heard before the toolbox arrives.
pairings.household_agreement: Start disagreements with a listening interval, then ask whether advice is wanted.
pairings.avoid: Do not answer a confession with a maintenance checklist.
pairings.bureau_note: Their first successful date consisted of Basalt saying: that sounds difficult, without adding a solution.

pairings.title: The safety briefing and the confetti cannon
pairings.explanation: Basalt can offer reassuring structure, while Pumice brings play. Trouble starts when protection becomes constant correction.
pairings.household_agreement: Schedule a short lively play period followed by separate quiet activities.
pairings.avoid: Do not make Pumice earn affection by sitting perfectly still.
pairings.bureau_note: Pumice was delighted by the evacuation map and immediately colored it as a treasure hunt.

pairings.title: A travel permit for spontaneity
pairings.explanation: Sandstone wants unexpected adventures; Basalt wants to know when everybody will be home. Neither wish is inherently a rejection of the other.
pairings.household_agreement: Agree on a return ritual and announce outings without demanding a full expedition plan.
pairings.avoid: Do not confuse a little mess with a disciplinary incident.
pairings.bureau_note: Basalt eventually accepted postcards as a legitimate branch of risk reporting.

pairings.title: A protector learning indoor footsteps
pairings.explanation: Basalt means to help, but a booming protective voice can make Shale withdraw. Gentle consistency works better than visible command.
pairings.household_agreement: Use quiet invitations, keep Shale's retreat accessible and let Shale initiate closeness.
pairings.avoid: No surprise inspections, raised voices or encouragement to toughen up.
pairings.bureau_note: Their best conversation happened through notes slid beneath a tiny imaginary door.

pairings.title: Companionship in well-labeled silence
pairings.explanation: Both value predictable space and promises kept. Slate helps Basalt rest without treating rest as negligence.
pairings.household_agreement: Offer a shared quiet corner and explicit permission to spend time apart.
pairings.avoid: Do not mistake their low-volume affection for a lack of attachment.
pairings.bureau_note: Their anniversary card contained a single check mark. Both cried internally.

pairings.title: A very competent committee of plot twists
pairings.explanation: They share creativity and resilience, but simultaneous improvisation can leave practical needs unattended.
pairings.household_agreement: Rotate responsibility for the stable routine while the other proposes experiments.
pairings.avoid: Do not change both the plan and the backup plan without telling each other.
pairings.bureau_note: They built a rotating chore wheel that briefly became a musical instrument.

pairings.title: The plan and its tasteful variations
pairings.explanation: They respect each other's complexity. Granite grounds shared projects while Gneiss prevents every decision becoming permanent policy.
pairings.household_agreement: Let one plan the essentials and the other suggest reversible experiments.
pairings.avoid: Do not label every new idea a breach of tradition.
pairings.bureau_note: Their book club includes books, discussion and one unexplained stripe-themed intermission.

pairings.title: Tradition learns a new dance step
pairings.explanation: Gneiss can refresh routines without mocking their meaning. Limestone gives inventive projects a sense of belonging.
pairings.household_agreement: Keep the purpose of a ritual while allowing small agreed variations.
pairings.avoid: Do not announce that all traditions are canceled as a practical joke.
pairings.bureau_note: The annual family recital now includes one tasteful stripe of improvisation.

pairings.title: The grand performance acquires jazz hands
pairings.explanation: Gneiss enjoys Marble's creativity but may joke at moments Marble considers solemn. They need an agreed line between play and ridicule.
pairings.household_agreement: Agree when improvisation is welcome and reserve some rituals exactly as requested.
pairings.avoid: Do not remix a heartfelt speech without permission.
pairings.bureau_note: The wedding march survived, except for one authorized kazoo.

pairings.title: The improviser needs subtitles
pairings.explanation: Gneiss means playful variation; Obsidian may hear uncertainty about the relationship. Clear context makes humor safer.
pairings.household_agreement: Explain plan changes plainly and agree on topics that are not used for teasing.
pairings.avoid: Do not answer requests for reassurance with another riddle.
pairings.bureau_note: Their fridge note says: new dinner plan, same affection.

pairings.title: A workshop full of manageable nonsense
pairings.explanation: Gneiss can turn Pumice's energy into shared projects without treating curiosity as a defect.
pairings.household_agreement: Choose short creative tasks and announce the transition to rest in advance.
pairings.avoid: No projects that require constant activity to maintain approval.
pairings.bureau_note: Their cardboard spaceship has excellent ventilation and no intention of obeying orbital mechanics.

pairings.title: The expedition has a backup snack
pairings.explanation: Both welcome novelty, and Gneiss can add just enough structure to make Sandstone's plans comfortable for everyone.
pairings.household_agreement: Agree on the essentials and leave room for small improvised detours.
pairings.avoid: Do not mistake a flexible plan for permission to ignore individual care needs.
pairings.bureau_note: They took a scenic route to the kettle and returned with a plausible map.

pairings.title: Improvisation with advance notice
pairings.explanation: Gneiss is considerate enough to adapt, but rapid changes can still unsettle Shale. Predictability around the essentials matters.
pairings.household_agreement: Announce changes early and offer a quiet alternative to group projects.
pairings.avoid: No surprise percussion sessions, even if the rhythm spells an apology.
pairings.bureau_note: The jazz rehearsal became a handwritten playlist. Shale gave it an excellent review.

pairings.title: Creative chaos with labeled drawers
pairings.explanation: Gneiss brings ideas and Slate supplies clarity. Their balance works when organization is supportive rather than a judgment of personality.
pairings.household_agreement: Keep a shared project space separate from the quiet resting area.
pairings.avoid: No rearranging private drawers as an exercise in spontaneity.
pairings.bureau_note: The improvised sculpture has a catalog number. Both consider this a victory.

pairings.title: The permanently adjourned furniture meeting

conditions.source_quote: set a friendly decision deadline for shared arrangements.

pairings.explanation: They are wonderfully dependable but may postpone every change until both have considered every consequence twice.
pairings.household_agreement: Rotate small decisions and set a friendly decision deadline for shared arrangements.
pairings.avoid: Do not require unanimous approval for every cushion adjustment.
pairings.bureau_note: The first meeting to discuss spontaneous fun is provisionally scheduled for next spring.

pairings.title: The dependable Sunday dinner
pairings.explanation: Both appreciate continuity and patient company. Limestone brings stories; Granite makes it safe to tell the same favorite story again.
pairings.household_agreement: Keep familiar rituals while inviting one small new experience at a time.
pairings.avoid: Do not let nostalgia become a ban on every change.
pairings.bureau_note: Their family recipe includes one cup of patience and a sedimentary amount of gravy.

pairings.title: The patron and the publicity department
pairings.explanation: Granite's dependable affection suits Marble, but its restrained delivery may look like indifference unless spoken aloud.
pairings.household_agreement: Agree on modest, regular appreciation rituals and protected quiet time.
pairings.avoid: Do not use extravagant gifts as a substitute for clear attention.
pairings.bureau_note: Granite's annual review said excellent companion. Marble requested it be read with orchestral backing.

pairings.title: A steady audience for complicated feelings
pairings.explanation: Granite's patient presence gives Obsidian room to speak without defending its intensity. Obsidian notices affection hidden beneath Granite's practical manner.
pairings.household_agreement: Use direct reassurance and private conversations rather than guessing at silence.
pairings.avoid: No public jokes about sensitivity or emotional overengineering.
pairings.bureau_note: Granite listened to all three acts of the problem and did not ask when the interval was.

pairings.title: The agenda acquires stickers
pairings.explanation: Pumice helps Granite try new things; Granite offers a dependable landing place. Pace differences need accommodation rather than blame.
pairings.household_agreement: Alternate a predictable shared activity with a brief playful one.
pairings.avoid: Do not schedule an entire day of compulsory stillness or compulsory excitement.
pairings.bureau_note: Pumice added a standing item called pleasant nonsense to the household agenda.

pairings.title: Roots and a borrowed suitcase
pairings.explanation: Granite enjoys a stable base; Sandstone enjoys returning to one. They struggle only when permanence is interpreted as never going anywhere.
pairings.household_agreement: Keep a familiar home corner and agree on room for short adventures.
pairings.avoid: Do not turn every departure into a referendum on loyalty.
pairings.bureau_note: Granite secretly keeps every postcard, filed by how much it missed the sender.

pairings.title: The archive gets a trustworthy custodian
pairings.explanation: Granite can wait for Shale's thoughts without demanding a performance. Shale rewards that patience with dry jokes and careful attention.
pairings.household_agreement: Offer slow introductions and quiet companionship with no compulsory conversation.
pairings.avoid: Do not answer on Shale's behalf just because a pause is long.
pairings.bureau_note: It took a week to exchange a joke. Both agreed it was worth the preparation.

pairings.title: Order without constant supervision
pairings.explanation: Granite likes agreements and Slate likes clear boundaries. Both can enjoy steady companionship without filling every silence.
pairings.household_agreement: Write down shared expectations and keep a private shelf for each.
pairings.avoid: Do not transform their tidy household into a competitive inspection.
pairings.bureau_note: Visitors describe the atmosphere as a library that remembers to offer tea.

pairings.title: Whose ancestral soup is this anyway
pairings.explanation: They share tenderness and love of tradition, but each may assume its family ritual is the only comforting one.
pairings.household_agreement: Alternate rituals and give sentimental belongings separate respectful spaces.
pairings.avoid: No competitive ancestry or declaring one family story more authentic.
pairings.bureau_note: Two soup recipes entered mediation. Both recipes were imaginary; the feelings were not.

pairings.title: The family album goes to finishing school
pairings.explanation: They enjoy rituals, but Marble may try to improve Limestone's cherished objects for presentation. Affection needs respect for sentimental imperfections.
pairings.household_agreement: Separate display decisions from treasured personal keepsakes and ask before tidying.
pairings.avoid: Do not polish away a memory or call an heirloom an unfortunate aesthetic choice.
pairings.bureau_note: The old soup bowl now wears a ribbon, strictly by consent.

pairings.title: Comfort without unwanted excavation
pairings.explanation: Limestone offers genuine tenderness but may ask too many questions about Obsidian's past. Care works when curiosity respects consent.
pairings.household_agreement: Ask whether company, advice or solitude is wanted before opening the memory album.
pairings.avoid: Do not dig for a backstory to explain every quiet evening.
pairings.bureau_note: The approved phrase is would you like tea, not who hurt your tectonic plates.

pairings.title: The story gets a very enthusiastic audience
pairings.explanation: Limestone enjoys being listened to and Pumice finds every old story astonishing. Gentle warmth gives Pumice a place to settle.
pairings.household_agreement: Alternate storytelling with small playful activities and keep rest time predictable.
pairings.avoid: Do not cast Limestone as an unpaid full-time babysitter.
pairings.bureau_note: Pumice applauded the same ancestral soup story seven times, sincerely.

pairings.title: A home for the returning storyteller
pairings.explanation: Sandstone brings new experiences and Limestone provides a warm place to tell them. Their affection thrives on welcome rather than control.
pairings.household_agreement: Keep a familiar return ritual while allowing new stories and souvenirs.
pairings.avoid: Do not make travel souvenirs pass an ancestry exam.
pairings.bureau_note: A grain of imaginary desert sand was adopted into the family scrapbook.

pairings.title: The gentle archive reading circle
pairings.explanation: Both appreciate stories told at a humanely slow pace. Limestone offers warmth while Shale brings attentive, understated companionship.
pairings.household_agreement: Provide a calm corner and ask permission before sharing personal stories with visitors.
pairings.avoid: No mandatory group reminiscing or pressure to disclose difficult memories.
pairings.bureau_note: Their favorite activity is remembering a nice afternoon without organizing a reunion.

pairings.title: Warm hospitality with a closing time
pairings.explanation: Limestone offers companionship without needing a spectacular response; Slate contributes clear boundaries that keep visits comfortable.
pairings.household_agreement: Agree on visiting hours and keep a private shelf for sentimental objects.
pairings.avoid: Do not equate a request for solitude with ingratitude.
pairings.bureau_note: Slate wrote a thank-you note for being allowed to leave a lovely gathering early.

pairings.title: Two divas and a negotiable spotlight
pairings.explanation: They understand the pleasure of being appreciated, but admiration can become a scarce resource if every moment is a competition.
pairings.household_agreement: Alternate small celebrations and give equal private reassurance outside performances.
pairings.avoid: No ranking beauty, brilliance, pedigree or curtain-call duration.
pairings.bureau_note: The household owns two identical spotlights and a surprisingly detailed peace agreement.

pairings.title: Opening night in the hall of mirrors
pairings.explanation: Both need to feel seen, but Marble seeks an audience where Obsidian seeks intimacy. Shared attention can turn into painful comparison.
pairings.household_agreement: Prefer separate households and short visits with no competitions or public ranking.
pairings.avoid: No beauty contests, dramatic jealousy exercises or jokes about who is the real star.
pairings.bureau_note: An astrologer blamed Venus. The shelter report blamed a single spotlight and two acceptance speeches.

pairings.title: Applause with scheduled intervals
pairings.explanation: Pumice loves a performance and Marble loves an appreciative friend. Both need reminders that ordinary quiet days still count as friendship.
pairings.household_agreement: Schedule a small show-and-tell and an equally respected no-performance period.
pairings.avoid: Do not reward escalating drama with unlimited attention.
pairings.bureau_note: The standing ovation lasted until a staff member introduced the concept of sitting.

pairings.title: The museum floor meets the beach holiday
pairings.explanation: Marble may experience Sandstone's casual clutter as disrespect, while Sandstone feels judged for simply being at home. Repeated correction erodes warmth.
pairings.household_agreement: Prefer separate households; shared visits need a clearly designated informal space.
pairings.avoid: No shame-based cleaning rituals or jokes that Sandstone is shedding its dignity.
pairings.bureau_note: Marble described one imaginary grain of sand as an installation without curatorial approval.

pairings.title: The whisper and the chandelier
pairings.explanation: Marble's expressive arrivals can overwhelm Shale. Shale's quiet retreat can feel like public rejection to Marble, creating an exhausting loop.
pairings.household_agreement: Prefer separate households and small planned visits without an audience.
pairings.avoid: Do not ask Shale to applaud through distress or Marble to regard silence as an insult.
pairings.bureau_note: A chandelier appeared in the archive. Nobody admitted ordering it.

pairings.title: Curtain calls before library hours
pairings.explanation: Marble can enjoy a quiet, loyal audience if Slate's need for silence is respected. Slate must be able to decline a performance without emotional penalties.
pairings.household_agreement: Set predictable performance windows and a protected quiet period afterward.
pairings.avoid: No passive-aggressive encores outside the agreed hours.
pairings.bureau_note: Slate applauds in writing. Marble frames every review.

pairings.title: Two mirrors, four interpretations
pairings.explanation: They understand emotional nuance but can reflect each other's anxiety until a small sigh becomes a multi-season mystery.
pairings.household_agreement: Ask direct questions and use separate retreat spaces before discussing difficult feelings.
pairings.avoid: No tests of affection based on whether the other guessed an unspoken need.
pairings.bureau_note: They once spent an afternoon apologizing for different imaginary offenses.

pairings.title: The private diary meets a megaphone
pairings.explanation: Pumice tends to share excitement publicly; Obsidian needs privacy and deliberate emotional boundaries. Good intentions do not erase repeated embarrassment.
pairings.household_agreement: Prefer separate households; brief supervised play should have explicit privacy rules.
pairings.avoid: Do not announce Obsidian's feelings to the room or treat retreat as a party invitation.
pairings.bureau_note: Pumice introduced a secret as our exciting new group project. The curtains closed immediately.

pairings.title: A dramatic goodbye needs a return ticket
pairings.explanation: Sandstone's wandering interests can look like rejection to Obsidian. Clear communication lets curiosity coexist with attachment.
pairings.household_agreement: Announce departures, return as agreed and leave reassuring notes without making grand vows.
pairings.avoid: No disappearing as a joke or surprise abandonment games.
pairings.bureau_note: A postcard saying back after snacks prevented an entire tragic monologue.

pairings.title: The confidential feelings department
pairings.explanation: Both appreciate privacy and careful invitations. They can recognize discomfort without requiring a public explanation.
pairings.household_agreement: Maintain quiet retreats and an agreed gentle way to check in.
pairings.avoid: Do not expect one withdrawn companion to guess every need of the other.
pairings.bureau_note: Their shared diary has two locks and a very moving entry about comfortable silence.

pairings.title: Private company, excellent punctuation
pairings.explanation: Slate respects privacy and Obsidian values intentional attention. Neither demands constant sociability to prove attachment.
pairings.household_agreement: Use explicit check-ins and a shared low-stimulation evening ritual.
pairings.avoid: Do not confuse respect for privacy with never asking how the other feels.
pairings.bureau_note: Their most romantic gesture was knocking before entering the imaginary emotional office.

pairings.title: The party that forgot to end
pairings.explanation: They match each other's enthusiasm so well that neither remembers to wind down. Shared excitement needs a gentle landing.
pairings.household_agreement: Provide short play sessions, a visible rest routine and separate settling spots.
pairings.avoid: No unlimited late-night visitors or competitive bouncing championships.
pairings.bureau_note: The neighbors received an invitation to celebrate the successful delivery of an invitation.

pairings.title: Expedition to the other end of the rug
pairings.explanation: Both enjoy small adventures and forgiving company. They are rarely offended by a little harmless disorder.
pairings.household_agreement: Keep adventures bounded and provide an easy return-to-rest ritual.
pairings.avoid: Do not confuse mutual enthusiasm with the absence of care needs.
pairings.bureau_note: They packed three maps and a biscuit to visit a houseplant.

pairings.title: Too many notifications for one little archive
pairings.explanation: Pumice's frequent invitations can overwhelm Shale even when each invitation is friendly. Shale's withdrawal can then make Pumice try harder.
pairings.household_agreement: Prefer separate households; occasional brief visits need a quiet exit available to Shale.
pairings.avoid: No repeated coaxing, surprise games or interpreting silence as consent.
pairings.bureau_note: Shale requested airplane mode. Pumice asked whether the airplane could come to dinner.

pairings.title: The silent reading room hosts a parade
pairings.explanation: Slate needs uninterrupted quiet and Pumice seeks frequent interaction. Sharing a resting area makes one feel invaded and the other rejected.
pairings.household_agreement: Prefer separate households; meeting time should be brief, planned and away from Slate's resting space.
pairings.avoid: Do not prescribe exposure to noise as a cure for Slate's preferences.
pairings.bureau_note: Pumice rang a bell to announce that it would now be quiet.

pairings.title: Two suitcases looking for a calendar
pairings.explanation: They understand each other's curiosity but can forget the stable rituals that make a shared home feel safe.
pairings.household_agreement: Keep one reliable daily check-in and a familiar resting area untouched by adventures.
pairings.avoid: No spontaneous relocation of the entire household while the other naps.
pairings.bureau_note: Both left a note saying gone exploring and met by accident at the same fern.

pairings.title: Postcards from a comfortable distance
pairings.explanation: Sandstone enjoys novelty; Shale prefers to examine it slowly. They can share stories without having to share every expedition.
pairings.household_agreement: Make invitations optional and let Shale choose when to hear about an adventure.
pairings.avoid: Do not surprise Shale with an unannounced group of new friends.
pairings.bureau_note: The most popular souvenir was a photograph of a place Shale did not have to visit.

pairings.title: An explorer with a quiet home port
pairings.explanation: Slate can appreciate Sandstone's stories when adventures do not repeatedly invade its private space.
pairings.household_agreement: Keep a protected quiet zone and ask before spreading souvenirs across shared shelves.
pairings.avoid: Do not convert Slate's resting place into temporary expedition headquarters.
pairings.bureau_note: The household border is marked by a tasteful sign reading: exciting things beyond this point.

pairings.title: A friendship in very small print
pairings.explanation: Their sensitivity is mutually understood, but both may withdraw at once and assume the other wants no company.
pairings.household_agreement: Use a gentle agreed check-in signal and allow separate retreats without guilt.
pairings.avoid: No guessing contests about who should initiate contact first.
pairings.bureau_note: They invented a bookmark system: green means company welcome, blue means quietly still friends.

pairings.title: The quiet shelf that feels like home
pairings.explanation: Both enjoy low-stimulation company and unhurried exchanges. Slate's clear boundaries make Shale's pauses easier to understand.
pairings.household_agreement: Offer separate private corners alongside a shared reading-time ritual.
pairings.avoid: Do not mistake their quiet preference for permission to leave every need unspoken.
pairings.bureau_note: They celebrated a month together by not inviting anyone, mutually and joyfully.

pairings.title: A duet for two comfortable silences
pairings.explanation: They usually understand each other's quiet affection and respect for personal space. Their home can be peaceful without being emotionally empty.
pairings.household_agreement: Use direct check-ins and distinguish chosen solitude from needing help.
pairings.avoid: Do not assume that perfect tidiness means every emotional need is met.
pairings.bureau_note: The Bureau visited once, whispered nice place, and was invited back next year.
